name: dftracer_papers
description: Literature search for citation-backed optimizations: arXiv, Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex, Crossref, CORE, DBLP and web search, webpage article extraction, relevance ranking, the local paper/article library with RAG retrieval (save_paper, rag_search, ...), and the optimization paper/context search for a run's bottlenecks; dftracer_papers_check validates citations offline. Load when a proposal needs a citation, or on HTTP 429 from Semantic Scholar, SSL certificate errors behind a corporate CA, an empty search result, or an uncited/malformed reference.
